name: IC Power Linear Regulator — 3.3V, LDO — VSSOP
description: Surface-mount 3.3V low-dropout linear voltage regulator ICs in VSSOP packaging utilizing VSSOP-8_3x3mm_P0.65mm footprints.
selection_hints: Select for 3.3V low-dropout linear regulation applications requiring SMD VSSOP packages.
Verify board layout matches the VSSOP-8_3x3mm_P0.65mm footprint.
Choose among Tier A linear regulator parts such as LP2951-3.3_VSSOP or LP3982IMM-3.3.
avoid_when: A voltage rail other than 3.3V is required.
The circuit design requires a switching regulator or non-LDO topology.
The PCB layout requires through-hole mounting or package footprints other than VSSOP-8.
